title: Settings in a repo's .codex/config.toml are ignored by Codex
symptoms: sandbox_mode or model set in the project .codex/config.toml has no effect
Project hooks and rules under .codex do not run
cause: Codex loads project .codex/ layers, including config, hooks, and rules, only for trusted projects. A project marked untrusted, or never trusted, gets user and system config only.
fix: Trust the project when Codex asks, or mark it trusted in user config.
affected: Codex CLI, IDE extension, and ChatGPT desktop app, as of 2026-10
